AC1 — cli/internal/bead/internal/lifecycle/watcher_hub.go exists (package lifecycle) with WatcherHub, NewWatcherHub, projectWatcher, genLifecycleEventID, polling loop, SubscribeLifecycle, and factory-error propagation. cli/internal/bead/watcher.go is absent (relocated by earlier commits 4a3b7fa306 / 33ece220d5 under parent lineage ddx-eca2d238 / ddx-69591a68).
2. AC2 — Public bead.LifecycleEvent and bead.LifecycleSubscriber remain the stable surface in cli/internal/bead/backend.go. Public construction is bead.NewLifecycleSubscriber (factory.go), which adapts lifecycle.WatcherHub and converts lifecycle.Event → bead.LifecycleEvent.
